name: Defeat
overview: Scripture reveals that true victory over defeat begins with wholehearted obedience to God's commandments, as promised in Deuteronomy 28:1, where God sets His people above all nations when they diligently follow Him. In times of trouble, God remains our constant refuge and strength, providing present help as affirmed in Psalms 46:1. The unchanging nature of God, declared in Malachi 3:6, ensures that His people are not consumed despite challenges. Jesus' teaching in Matthew 4:7 underscores reliance on God's Word to resist temptation, while Matthew 5:19 highlights the importance of faithfully keeping and teaching God's commandments as a mark of greatness in His kingdom. Loving God fully and loving others, as taught in Luke 10:27, grounds believers in a life that overcomes defeat through obedience and trust in Him.
